intro.text: A laborer from Elendel's slums and a customer of the First Central Bank.

items.text: Around 311, twelve-year-old Wax watched with his uncle Edwarn as Jendel, a father of three, sought a loan beside a rich man named Nikolin. Edwarn explained that his bank lent to risky borrowers like Jendel, but on harsh terms such as steep interest and wage garnishment.

Hearing the terms, Wax tried to give Jendel a rare coin Edwarn had just handed him, but Jendel couldn't believe anyone would give it away. Edwarn smoothly talked him into signing anyway. Unable to keep up the payments, Jendel jumped from a bridge eight years on, and his sons stayed in debt to the bank.
Wax told Steris the story after Bleeder sent him a message on that same coin, saying the episode was part of why he left Elendel for the Roughs.

appearance.text: Middle-aged, in dusty clothes and a felt cap.
